jobs.description: Are you passionate about using technology to save lives and prevent injuries? Do you want to lead the invention and construction of safety solutions that will protect hundreds of thousands of third-party drivers across Amazon's vast middle mile and delivery networks? Amazon is building disruptive safety technology products with the vision of creating the safest middle mile and last mile delivery operations in the world. We are studying the safety needs of line haul and delivery drivers and building innovative, market-leading solutions that will fundamentally transform how we protect drivers on the road every day. You will be both an entrepreneur and an operator who will plan and scale safety technology across the driver network. You will define the driver safety experience, partner with Tech, Engineering, Operations, Safety, Legal, and Compliance teams to design solutions that make for safer on road operations. You will thrive in ambiguity, building and communicating a clear approach and ensuring that we are delivering strong safety outcomes with each technology deployment that impacts on road operations. You will be expected to regularly display the following abilities: 1) High ownership and accountability for driver safety outcomes with the ability to plan and deliver on critical safety goals 2) Ability to navigate ambiguity with flexibility and decisiveness while balancing safety improvements with operational priorities 3) Skills to work across diverse stakeholders teams to communicate, convince and deliver for the goal and 4) Ability to think big on a vision for transformative driver safety technology while being rooted in constant execution and measurable safety improvements. This is a highly visible and inherently critical role with room to innovate and solve key road safety challenges at scale. Strong experience designing and launching impactful products in a complex and cross-functional environment is necessary. Key job responsibilities · Develop a thorough understanding of safety challenges facing middle mile truck drivers and last mile delivery drivers, including vehicle safety, road safety, route optimization for driver protection, fatigue management, and incident prevention while monitoring new developments in driver safety technology and the regulatory landscape. · Define and own the driver safety product roadmap and strategy – develop the vision for implementing next-generation safety solutions including vehicle telematics, driver assistance systems, in-vehicle safety technology, predictive safety analytics, and real-time risk mitigation tools for drivers across all regions and operations. · Write and present compelling business cases (backed by strong research and driver safety data analysis) for safety technology investments in partnership with all stakeholder teams · Partner with Tech, Operations, Engineering, Safety, Compliance, and Legal teams to design customer backward safety experiences that protect drivers in Amazon's delivery network. · Own end-to-end product development from requirements to launch – write business requirement specifications, monitor project execution, and ensure delivery is to the appropriate levels of quality and safety standards. · Monitor and report on driver safety metrics and KPIs to senior leadership across Amazon, as related to the safety products being developed and deployed – track driver incident rates, near-miss events, safety technology adoption, and demonstrate measurable improvements in driver safety across middle mile and last mile operations. · Drive adoption of safety features across the third-party driver network – ensure that safety solutions are effectively planned, implemented and utilized by drivers across thousands of line haul routes and delivery routes · Ensure compliance with Department of Transportation (DOT), Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA), Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), and other regulatory requirements while staying ahead of evolving driver safety regulations · Manage complex, multi-stakeholder programs with compressed timelines – be tenacious and find creative approaches to meet deadlines and delivery the product roadmap. · Create clear, effective written communication to present decision points or data-based arguments that enable delivering on driver safety goals. Communicate to diverse audiences ranging from technical teams to senior leadership. A day in the life Amazon Benefits: Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

jobs.description: Use Your Power for Purpose At Pfizer, our purpose is to deliver breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. In this role, you will contribute to the discovery and advancement of innovative medicines for patients worldwide by applying rigorous science, modern pharmacology, and cutting-edge technologies. Your work will help transform promising therapeutic ideas into high-quality experimental data that enable confident decisions across the drug discovery process. What You Will Achieve A key strategic focus within the Internal Medicine Research Unit (IMRU) is the discovery of novel therapies for obesity, cardiovascular disease, and related cardiometabolic conditions. As an Associate Scientist in the In Vitro Pharmacology group, you will contribute to early drug discovery programs by generating rigorous, reproducible pharmacology data that support target validation, assay development, compound profiling, and mechanism-of-action studies. This role is well suited for a collaborative, hands-on scientist with experience in cell-based assay execution, mammalian cell culture, quantitative data analysis, and an interest in receptor pharmacology within cardiometabolic drug discovery. How You Will Achieve It Develop, optimize, and execute cell-based signaling, ligand-binding, and other in vitro pharmacology assays to generate high-quality data that support project decisions. Support compound profiling and mechanism-of-action studies through careful experimental design, troubleshooting, and quantitative data analysis. Maintain mammalian cell cultures and prepare fit-for-purpose cellular or membrane-based assay reagents to support screening, binding, and functional assay workflows. Apply core pharmacology concepts, including ligand potency, efficacy and affinity to interpret experimental results. Work collaboratively with pharmacology colleagues and cross-functional project teams to support experimental priorities, data interpretation, and program objectives. Summarize and communicate experimental findings clearly in team meetings, project discussions, and written updates. Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant experimental records in an electronic laboratory notebook. Qualifications Must-Have Bachelor’s degree with any years of laboratory experience. Nice- to-Have Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture and cell-based assay execution. Familiarity with core pharmacology concepts, concentration-response analysis, and principles of robust assay execution. Experience analyzing and visualizing pharmacology data using Microsoft Excel, GraphPad Prism, or similar tools. Interest in receptor pharmacology, GPCR signaling, obesity or cardiometabolic drug discovery. Exposure to compound profiling, screening workflows, assay miniaturization, membrane-based assays, second messenger signaling assays, or emerging technologies to interrogate receptor function is preferred but not required. Ability to organize, execute, and troubleshoot experiments with attention to detail, scientific rigor, and data quality. Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present experimental results in individual and group settings. Ability to manage multiple priorities and contribute effectively to a collaborative, cross-functional research environment. Scientific curiosity, enthusiasm for learning, and motivation to contribute to the discovery of new medicines for patients. Unity is at the forefront with our scalable, performant runtime engine and Unity Editor workflow. We are looking for a senior software engineer to join our growing team. The team builds and supports the Unity versions that run on Embedded platforms, like Embedded Linux, QNX and Android Automotive OS. As UX evolves to include multiple screens, layering of 3D content with other applications and rich multi-touch input, our platform grows to match expectations. Unity is committed to solving the hardest technical challenges, and this role plays a key part in delivering industry solutions for our customers. You will work with teams across Unity, including industry teams who work directly with customers and R&D teams responsible for cross-platform support, systems architecture, libraries, as well as runtime optimization. What success looks like In your first 3-6 months, you've ramped up on one of our embedded platforms, shipped your first integrations and bug fixes, and become a trusted contributor in customer-facing investigations. Within 12 months, you own a meaningful area of a platform (e.g. AAOS integration) its performance on constrained embedded SoCs and act as a technical point of contact for one of our customers. You'll help define the technical bar across the team and shape how Unity supports the next generation of software-defined vehicles. Profile and optimize KPI like runtime performance, memory, startup/load time and iteration speed of Unity for resource-constrained embedded SoCs across platforms. Partner directly with customers like automotive OEMs as a technical point of contact, investigating issues, removing performance bottlenecks, and setting customers up for production success. jobs.description: At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us. This is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting-edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale, high-density facilities where you will help change the face of cloud technology in the region — and your work will directly impact millions of customers. This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Data Center Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs. Who Should Apply We welcome applications from: Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar. About the Role As a Data Center Technician Intern, you will work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair. You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful. What You Will Do You will provide our internal teams with infrastructure-related support, resolving tickets related to hardware (motherboards, Random Access Memory, Central Processing Units, Graphics Processing Units, and more) and networking (link-down events, optics replacements, switch replacements, and more). In addition to hardware and network repair, you will learn how to install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix complex problems within the data center environment. Your day-to-day duties include: - Troubleshooting server hardware alongside experienced AWS technicians - Meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) against assigned trouble tickets - Shadowing AWS technicians during network troubleshooting to build your diagnostic skills - Replacing media (Solid State Drives and Hard Disk Drives) in accordance with AWS Data Tech guidance - Performing regular server hardware repairs (drives, motherboards, and other components) under the guidance of experienced technicians - Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site Internship Structure Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday. Please note that a full-time Data Center Technician position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position. Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying. Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go. From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will diagnose and repair the servers and networks that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale. Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. Every server you repair and every network issue you resolve keeps the cloud running. Action. You will move fast, learn by doing, and solve real problems from day one. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice. Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon. Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape. A day in the life Watch a day in the life of a Data Center Technician https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AKi0LtjSO4M About the team AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers — in an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them.

jobs.description: Oxy produces , markets and transports oil and natural gas to maximize value and provide resources fundamental to life. 쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

리테일
비즈니스
소개
우리는 주어진 역할을 넘어 과감한 실행력을 지향합니다. 쿠팡 리테일은 로켓배송의 압도적인 성장을 실질적인 비즈니스 성과로 창출해 나가고 있는 핵심 조직입니다. 쿠팡 리테일에서는 카테고리 전략과 수익구조를 직접 설계하며 유통 산업의 새로운 표준을 정립합니다. 데이터와 고객 중심 사고로 성장을 견인할 시니어/리드급 인재에게 쿠팡은 커리어 확장의 최고 무대가 될 것입니다. 정해진 답을 따르기 보다 과감한 시도로 성과를 증명해 온 분이라면, 로켓배송과 함께 그 가치를 더 크게 키워 보시기 바랍니다.
로켓 배송 소개
로켓배송은 세계적 수준의 압도적인 기술과 물류 인프라를 바탕으로 오늘 주문하면 내일 도착하는 쿠팡의 핵심 서비스입니다. 상품의 직접 매입부터 보관, 배송, 반품까지 전 과정을 쿠팡이 책임지는 End-to-End 방식입니다.

[인터뷰] 쿠팡 BM을 만나다
업무 내용
카테고리 전략 수립 및 브랜드 발굴·성장 관리
: 시장과 고객 데이터를 활용하여 카테고리의 중장기 전략을 수립하고, 이를 기반으로 잠재력 있는 브랜드를 발굴하고 입점시킵니다. 브랜드와의 동반 성장하며 로켓배송의 성장 기반을 확보합니다.
브랜드 파트너십 구축 및 비즈니스 구조 설계
: 브랜드사와의 협업을 통하여 로켓배송의 상품들을 직매입합니다. 브랜드사와 함께 마케팅 조건을 설계하고, 상호 성장을 할 수 있도록 파트너십을 운영합니다.
카테고리 성과(P&L) 관리 및 상품·프로모션 전략 수립
: 매출·수익 등 핵심 지표를 관리하고, 이를 기반으로 상품과 프로모션 전략을 수립합니다. 시장에서 경쟁력 있는 가격을 트래킹하고, 공급가 협의를 통하여 성장을 이끕니다.
운영 프로세스 총괄 관리
: 업체의 니즈와 운영 기준 사이가 균형있도록 조율하고, 상품 등록, 재고 운영, 가격 정책, 프로모션 실행 등 운영의 전반을 체계적으로 관리합니다.
운영 프로세스 개선 및 유관 부서 협업
: 마케팅·물류·카탈로그 운영 등 유관 부서와의 협업을 통하여 근본 원인 분석하고 및 개선을 실행합니다.

Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?
Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.
PlayStation isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Today, we’re recognized as a global leader in entertainment producing The PlayStation family of products and services including PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, PlayStation®VR, PlayStation®Plus, acclaimed PlayStation software titles from PlayStation Studios, and more.
PlayStation also strives to create an inclusive environment that empowers employees and embraces diversity. We welcome and encourage everyone who has a passion and curiosity for innovation, technology, and play to explore our open positions and join our growing global team.
The PlayStation brand falls under Sony Interactive Entertainment, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sony Corporation.
Staff Software Engineer – Data
Do you want to join a team of talented engineers building the next generation of real-time data platforms that power analytics and data-driven experiences across PlayStation? As part of our Data Platform team, you will play a key technical leadership role in designing and evolving the Real-Time Analytics Platform (RTAP), enabling high-throughput, low-latency analytics and stream processing at PlayStation scale.
The Software Engineers within our Platform Engineering Group design, build, document, and operate large-scale distributed data platforms that support real-time and near real-time analytics across PlayStation. You will solve complex distributed systems challenges, evolve our streaming and analytics architecture, integrate AI-powered platform capabilities, and improve scalability, reliability, performance, and developer productivity.
We’re looking for someone who is passionate about distributed systems, real-time analytics, and building scalable data platforms. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Security, and Data Engineering teams to shape technical strategy, influence architecture across organizations, mentor engineers, and help drive the long-term evolution of PlayStation’s data platform.
Responsibilities
·
Design, build, and operate large-scale distributed data systems that power real-time and near real-time analytics,, and data-driven applications across PlayStation.
·
Lead the architecture and evolution of RTAP’s stream processing and analytics platforms, improving scalability, reliability, performance, and developer productivity.
·
Own critical platform capabilities end-to-end from architecture and implementation through production operations, performance optimization, reliability, and lifecycle management.
·
Build and optimize distributed data services using technologies such as Apache Flink, Spark Structured Streaming, ClickHouse, and Apache Druid to support high-throughput, low-latency workloads.
·
Partner with Data Engineering teams to integrate batch and streaming workloads using modern lakehouse architectures and build interoperable, scalable data platforms.
·
Build AI-powered capabilities to automate engineering workflows, improve data quality, simplify platform operations, accelerate troubleshooting, and enhance developer productivity.
·
Establish technical standards and engineering best practices for distributed systems, stream processing, data modeling, query optimization and platform reliability.
·

·

·
Investigate and resolve complex production challenges involving high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems, ensuring high availability and operational excellence.
·
Participate in the team's production support and on-call rotation, leading incident response, conducting root-cause analysis, and implementing reliability improvements that strengthen the platform over time

Evaluate emerging technologies and distributed data platforms, recommending investments that improve scalability, reliability, developer productivity, and cost efficiency.

Real-Time Analytics Platform
and its role within PlayStation’s broader data ecosystem. You will be comfortable owning complex distributed systems initiatives, partnering closely with Product and Engineering teams, and driving large-scale solutions from architecture through production delivery.
